_fix.pixels_why: Review 3 A3: tile 15's one white-hot pixel (tile x 11, y 7) repeated at the same spot on every all-magma tile, a 16 px grid of white sparks over every pool; it becomes the swirl colour, leaving the tile's two #e8c170 px. Each variant carries one white-hot pixel of its own instead. Edge tiles keep theirs (they always come from this sheet).
_fix.why: The saturated raw lava snapped mostly to #da863e with #e8c170 swirls; shifted one step down to STYLE's magma accent (#cf573c base, #da863e swirls, #e8c170/#ebede9 only in the hottest spots) so heat machines' #e8c170/#ebede9 cores outshine it. Hot-ground colours are untouched: tile 0 equals t_l4_floor_hot's tile 15 pixel for pixel.
